events.text: Applied GUIDING_LIGHT to the asset compiler: spec Part 7.3/7.9 reframed the cooked-asset envelope as SEPARABLE content-addressed FACTORS (mesh blob / texture blob / descriptor) referenced by hash — never a baked product; hash IS the cache key (idempotent re-cook); declarative-not-code (no per-asset scripts); derive-don't-store-twice (collision MEASURED from the mesh). The Phase 7a code (cookedAsset.ts/cookedAssetStream.ts) implements exactly this — blobs interned once by sha256, one model→prop+item shares meshRef. Standing directive going forward.

resolution: Applied the GUIDING_LIGHT.md discipline to the whole asset-compiler design and implementation. The Part 7 spec was reframed (§7.3 + a new §7.9) so the cooked-asset envelope is a SUM of separable, content-addressed FACTORS — the mesh blob and texture blob interned once by their own sha256 and referenced, the descriptor the only per-kind factor — never a baked product; the shipped artifact is the existing flat binary (MESH_PROPS + content-addressed assets[]), not JSON at runtime; the hash IS the cache key so re-cooking an unchanged model is a no-op; descriptors stay declarative data parameterizing fixed engine capabilities (no per-asset scripts); collision/footprint are MEASURED from the mesh (derive, don't store twice). The Phase 7a code implements exactly this — cookedAsset.ts hashes factors by reference, cookedAssetStream.ts dedups blobs by hash so one model cooked as prop + item shares the meshRef. This is a standing directive carried forward into the remaining slices.
